definitions.explanation: A general term encompassing both animal fats ({脂|あぶら}) and vegetable/liquid oils ({油|あぶら}). Used in food science, chemistry, and industrial contexts.

examples.japanese: {油脂|ゆし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}える→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧。
examples.english: To cut back on fats and oils.

examples.japanese: {動物性|どうぶつせい}{油脂|ゆし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{植物性|しょくぶつせい}{油脂|ゆし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are animal fats and vegetable oils.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{油脂|ゆし}⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれている→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: This food contains a high amount of fat.

notes:
Composed of {油|ゆ} (oil, liquid fat) + {脂|し} (fat, solid fat). This is the umbrella term covering both liquid oils (⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧) and solid fats (⟦{脂|あぶら}→脂：01916_abura⟧). Commonly found on food labels, in cooking discussions, and in scientific contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {動物性|どうぶつせい}{油脂|ゆし}: animal fat
- {植物性|しょくぶつせい}{油脂|ゆし}: vegetable oil
- {油脂|ゆし}⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧: fat content
- {油脂|ゆし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{含|ふく}む→含む：01982_fukumu⟧: to contain fat/oil

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{脂肪|しぼう}→脂肪：03199_shibou⟧: fat — used for body fat or dietary fat in general
- ⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧: oil — the everyday word for cooking oil or oily substances
- ⟦{脂|あぶら}→脂：01916_abura⟧: grease, fat — refers to solid/animal fat specifically
